title: Bo-Katan Kryze
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: Bo-Katan Kryze led a team of Clan Kryze Mandalorians striking back at the Imperial remnant. Kryze met The Mandalorian Din Djarin and the two shared a kinship that allowed Kryze to both return to their shared home planet and finally unite the opposing factions of her people.
